sections.title: Profile
paragraphs: Platform Engineer with 9 years of experience designing reliable backend services and cloud infrastructure. Works mostly with Go, Python and Kubernetes. Comfortable owning systems end to end, from architecture and delivery to on-call and cost optimisation. Enjoys writing documentation and mentoring teammates.

entries.heading: Northwind Systems
bullets: Designed and operated a Kubernetes-based internal platform serving around 60 engineering teams
Cut monthly cloud spend by 25% through autoscaling, right-sizing and clean-up of unused resources
Introduced service level objectives and an incident review process that reduced repeat incidents
Mentored two engineers moving from application development into infrastructure roles

entries.heading: Contoso Cloud
bullets: Built REST and gRPC services in Go for a multi-tenant billing product
Automated deployments with Terraform and a CI/CD pipeline, shortening release time from days to hours
Participated in an on-call rotation and wrote runbooks for the most common alerts
Worked with product and support teams to prioritise reliability improvements alongside new features

entries.heading: Fabrikam Data
bullets: Developed data import tools in Python for a reporting product
Improved test coverage of the import pipeline from 35% to 80%
Paired with senior engineers during code reviews and learned the team's release process

entries.heading: Open-source deployment checker
bullets: Command-line tool that validates Kubernetes manifests against team-defined policies before deployment
Adopted by a few hundred teams according to public download statistics

entries.heading: Conference talks and articles
bullets: Spoke at regional meetups about reliability engineering and published a series of articles on incident reviews

entries.heading: Riverton Institute of Technology
lines: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, graduated in 2016

entries.heading: Cycling and ceramics
lines: Long-distance bike touring in the summer and hand-built pottery in a community studio

footer: Consent to the processing of personal data for recruitment purposes is given by the candidate.
